scope: Possessory title under the Registration of Title Act 1964 and its interaction with adverse possession/prescription.

primary_statutory_sources.provisions: Part IV and relevant land limitation provisions

primary_statutory_sources.source: Land and Conveyancing Law Reform Act 2021

case_law_status.reason: Possessory title, adverse possession and prescriptive easements are legally distinct pathways and cannot be collapsed into a single case-law category.

system_rules: Possessory title is not the same legal question as adverse possession.
Adverse possession of registered land must be separated from prescriptive easement claims.
Historical possession questions require date-specific law.
The 2021 prescription reforms require transitional analysis for older claims.
No possessory-title conclusion is published without a verified primary case-law and statutory chain.
next_research: Search primary Irish judgments specifically concerning possessory title under the 1964 Act.
Map judgments to ss.49, 53 and 54 where applicable.
Separate registered-land adverse possession from easement prescription.
Record historical authorities and legal-version dates.
